issues.desc: CHK-002 scope is ambiguous. Background says this story is documentation-only, but the item wording around final-report.json/readiness checklist/authorityMode/evidenceClass/receiptVerified can be read as requiring schema or gate changes. Clarify whether the task is only to document these boundaries in the capability doc, or split any real process-fact/runtime changes into a separate story.

This story touches authority/proof/DONE semantics, so the checklist should state how consistency will be verified across the mode matrix and the report/readiness/DONE sections. Add explicit verification prep in checklist context so DEV/REVIEW do not have to infer the acceptance shape from background alone.
